explanation: This fires only at D1 and only near the end of the episode (about trial 92-99), when the previous trial outcome argues for switching: the previous trial was unrewarded, or it was rewarded after a rare transition. Then it is usually 7-10 (about 5-6 around trial 93, and lower when the agent has just switched to a2); every GO and D2 step, every trial before about 92, and every D1 after a rewarded common trial is 0.
